plugins.name: Board templates: retro + C4 sketch
plugins.description: Two ready-made whiteboard templates — a Start/Stop/Continue retrospective board and a C4-style container sketch. Instantiate the pack and the boards appear in your namespace, ready to edit.

plugins.name: Community connectors (n8n import)
plugins.description: Nine integration presets (Slack, Telegram, Discord, Notion, GitHub, Jira, Trello, Asana, Mattermost) converted from n8n community nodes with 'mockarty-cli plugin import --from n8n'.

plugins.name: Allure TestOps connector
plugins.description: A ready-to-use Allure TestOps connector — reuses the built-in Allure adapter to push launches and results.

plugins.name: Analytics API mock kit
plugins.description: An analytics contour (event ingest, funnels, metrics) — mock an analytics backend for dashboards.

plugins.name: API collection pack (HTTP smoke)
plugins.description: A content pack for the API Tester module: a ready-made HTTP collection of sample requests (list/get/create). Instantiate it to seed a namespace's API Tester. No code.

plugins.name: Recruiting/ATS API mock kit
plugins.description: An applicant-tracking contour (jobs, candidates, applications) — mock a recruiting backend.

plugins.name: OIDC auth mock kit
plugins.description: An OpenID-Connect provider contour (token, userinfo, jwks, discovery) — mock an identity provider for local auth flows without a real IdP.

plugins.name: Banking API mock kit
plugins.description: A retail-banking contour (accounts, transactions, cards, transfers) — mock a core-banking API for fintech development.

plugins.name: Barcode fakers (EAN/UPC/ISBN)
plugins.description: Adds $.fake.ean13, $.fake.upc and $.fake.isbn13 — retail barcodes with correct GS1 check digits. Sandboxed WASM.

plugins.name: Subscription billing API mock kit
plugins.description: A subscription-billing contour (plans, subscriptions, invoices) — mock a SaaS-billing backend.

plugins.name: Booking API mock kit
plugins.description: A reservations contour (availability, create/cancel reservation) — mock a booking backend for calendar/hotel/restaurant apps.

plugins.name: Contract starter pack (OpenAPI/GraphQL)
plugins.description: A content pack for the Contract testing module: seeds ready-to-use API contracts into the registry (an OpenAPI orders service and a GraphQL users service). Instantiate it into a namespace to get starter specs your consumers/providers can verify against. Requires the contract testing feature. No code.

plugins.name: CRM API mock kit
plugins.description: A CRM contour (contacts, companies, deals) — mock a Salesforce/HubSpot-style sales API.

plugins.name: Crypto fakers (ETH/BTC/tx)
plugins.description: Adds $.fake.eth_address, $.fake.tx_hash and $.fake.btc_address — synthetic blockchain identifiers for test data. Sandboxed WASM.

plugins.name: Custom runner task types
plugins.description: Declares runner task types (plugin-dbt-run, plugin-selenium-suite) so a vendor-shipped external runner advertising the matching capability can be dispatched jobs — the sidecar model, declaratively.

plugins.name: Date/time fakers (ISO/cron/duration)
plugins.description: Adds $.fake.iso_date, $.fake.iso_datetime, $.fake.cron and $.fake.duration — date/time shapes with no built-in equivalent. Sandboxed WASM.

plugins.name: Demo API mock kit
plugins.description: A ready-made contour of mocks for a tiny users API — the simplest kind of plugin (declarative content, no code). Enable it, then instantiate the kit into any namespace to get working /users endpoints instantly.

plugins.name: Deploy events
plugins.description: Adds deploy lifecycle event types (plugin.deploy.started / finished / failed) to the notification catalogue — subscribe to them per channel like any built-in event. Declarative, no code.

plugins.name: E-commerce API mock kit
plugins.description: A ready-made contour for a typical e-commerce backend — products, a cart and orders — with dynamic fakers. Declarative content, no code. Enable it, then instantiate into any namespace for instant /products, /cart and /orders endpoints.

plugins.name: E-signature API mock kit
plugins.description: An e-signature contour (envelopes, signers, status) — mock a DocuSign-style backend.

plugins.name: EU fakers (IBAN/BIC/VAT)
plugins.description: Adds $.fake.iban (German-format IBAN with a valid mod-97 checksum), $.fake.bic and $.fake.vat_de. Sandboxed WASM.

plugins.name: Feature flags mock kit
plugins.description: A feature-flag service contour (list flags, evaluate) — mock LaunchDarkly/Unleash-style flag evaluation.

plugins.name: Finance fakers (card/IBAN)
plugins.description: Adds $.fake.credit_card (16 digits, valid Luhn — a test PAN, never a real card) and $.fake.iban. Sandboxed WASM. A second WASM-faker example alongside ru-fakers.

plugins.name: Fitness/health API mock kit
plugins.description: A fitness-tracking contour (workouts, activity, goals) — mock a health-tracking backend.

plugins.name: Food delivery API mock kit
plugins.description: A food-delivery contour (restaurants, menus, orders, drivers) — mock a delivery-platform backend.

plugins.name: Format matchers (jwt/e164/ipv4)
plugins.description: Condition operators: plugin:jwt (value is a JWT), plugin:e164 (E.164 phone), plugin:ipv4 (dotted-quad IPv4). Sandboxed WASM, runs only on mocks that use the operator.

plugins.name: Gaming API mock kit
plugins.description: A gaming-backend contour (players, leaderboards, matches) — mock a game-services API.

plugins.name: Geocoding API mock kit
plugins.description: A geocoding contour (forward + reverse) returning coordinates and addresses — mock a maps/geocoding provider.

plugins.name: GitHub connector
plugins.description: A ready-to-use GitHub connector — reuses Mockarty's built-in GitHub adapter, no code. Link issues, pull requests and CI status to GitHub. A second connector example alongside jira-connector.

plugins.name: GitLab connector
plugins.description: A ready-to-use GitLab connector — reuses the built-in GitLab adapter, no code. Links issues, merge requests and pipelines to Mockarty.

plugins.name: Healthcare (FHIR-lite) mock kit
plugins.description: A FHIR-style healthcare contour (Patient, Observation) — mock a health-records API for integration testing. Structure mirrors FHIR resources; values are synthetic.

plugins.name: Support/helpdesk API mock kit
plugins.description: A helpdesk contour (tickets, agents, replies) — mock a support-desk backend (Zendesk-style).

plugins.name: HR & payroll API mock kit
plugins.description: An HR/payroll contour (employees, payslips, time-off) — mock an HRIS backend.

plugins.name: Identifier fakers (ULID/nanoid/hex)
plugins.description: Adds $.fake.ulid, $.fake.nanoid and $.fake.hex_token — common modern identifiers. Sandboxed WASM.

plugins.name: Insurance API mock kit
plugins.description: An insurance contour (policies, quotes, claims) — mock an insurance backend.

plugins.name: Inventory API mock kit
plugins.description: A warehouse/inventory contour (products, stock levels, warehouses) — mock an inventory backend for commerce flows.

plugins.name: IoT API mock kit
plugins.description: An IoT device contour (devices, telemetry, commands) — mock a device-management backend for IoT dashboards.

plugins.name: Jenkins connector
plugins.description: A ready-to-use Jenkins connector — reuses the built-in Jenkins adapter to trigger and read CI jobs from Mockarty.

plugins.name: Jira connector
plugins.description: A ready-to-use Jira connector — an example of extending Mockarty toward an external tool with no code. It reuses Mockarty's built-in Jira adapter and ships sensible defaults, so installing it gives you a pre-configured Jira integration in a couple of clicks.

plugins.name: Jira starter pack (project + issues)
plugins.description: A content pack for the Issue Tracker (Jira-style module): seeds a starter project with an epic, stories, a bug and a task. Instantiate it to bootstrap a namespace's tracker. No code.

plugins.name: Linear connector
plugins.description: A ready-to-use Linear connector — reuses the built-in Linear adapter to link Mockarty issues/tests to Linear.

plugins.name: LLM provider: Anthropic
plugins.description: A mocked Anthropic Messages API: streaming in Anthropic's own SSE event format (message_start → content_block_delta → message_stop), tool use, token counting, and the failures that matter — 429 with retry-after, 401, 500, overlong input. Point ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL at the mock and test without a key.

plugins.name: LLM provider: DeepSeek
plugins.description: A mocked DeepSeek API (OpenAI-compatible): chat with streaming, tool calling, a deepseek-reasoner reply carrying reasoning_content, balance, and the usual failure paths. Set the base URL to the mock and test without spending tokens.

plugins.name: LLM provider: Ollama (local)
plugins.description: A mocked Ollama server: the OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint with streaming and tool calling, plus the native /api/tags and /api/show. Lets CI exercise a local-model path without pulling multi-gigabyte weights.

plugins.name: LLM provider: OpenAI
plugins.description: A complete OpenAI-compatible contour: chat completions (streaming and not), tool calling, embeddings, models — plus the failures that actually break integrations: 429 with Retry-After, 401, 500, context-length, truncation and content filtering. Point your client's base URL at the mock and test without a key or a bill.

plugins.name: LLM provider: Qwen (DashScope)
plugins.description: A mocked Qwen API in DashScope's OpenAI-compatible mode: chat with streaming, tool calling, embeddings and the failure paths. Test a Qwen integration without a key or a quota.

plugins.name: Education/LMS API mock kit
plugins.description: A learning-management contour (courses, students, enrollments, grades) — mock an LMS backend.

plugins.name: Loyalty/rewards API mock kit
plugins.description: A loyalty-program contour (members, points, rewards) — mock a rewards backend.

plugins.name: Request matchers (luhn/divisible)
plugins.description: Adds mock condition operators: plugin:luhn (value passes the Luhn checksum — card/IMEI numbers) and plugin:divisible_by (value is an integer divisible by the operand). Sandboxed WASM, runs only on mocks that use the operator.

plugins.name: MCP server: Brave Search
plugins.description: A mocked Brave Search MCP server: web and local search with realistic result shapes, plus the quota error and the empty-result case an agent must handle gracefully. Test search-and-summarise flows deterministically, with no API key and no per-query cost.

plugins.name: MCP server: Fetch (web)
plugins.description: A mocked Fetch MCP server: retrieve a web page as markdown, with the failures an agent has to survive — 404, timeout, and a robots.txt refusal. Lets you test retrieval logic offline and deterministically.

plugins.name: MCP server: Filesystem
plugins.description: A mocked Filesystem MCP server: read, write, edit, list and search files, with the sandbox refusals a real one enforces (path outside the allowed directories, file not found). Test an agent's file-handling logic without letting it near a real disk.

plugins.name: MCP server: Git
plugins.description: A mocked Git MCP server: inspect status and diffs, read the log, create branches and commit — including the errors an agent hits (not a repository, nothing staged, merge conflict). Test a code agent's git flow without touching a working tree.

plugins.name: MCP server: GitHub
plugins.description: A mocked GitHub MCP server: search code, read files, open and comment on issues, list and create pull requests — with the failures an agent must handle (repository not found, insufficient permissions, rate limit). Drive an agent through a whole GitHub workflow without a token or a real repository.

plugins.name: MCP server: Memory (knowledge graph)
plugins.description: A mocked Memory MCP server: create entities and relations, add observations and search the graph. Gives an agent a deterministic memory contour to test recall logic against, with no shared state to reset between runs.

plugins.name: MCP server: Playwright (browser)
plugins.description: A mocked Playwright MCP server: navigate, snapshot, click, type, screenshot, evaluate and close — with real input schemas so an agent can drive it from tools/list alone. Includes failure cases (element not found, navigation timeout) so you can test how your agent recovers without launching a browser.

plugins.name: MCP server: PostgreSQL
plugins.description: A mocked PostgreSQL MCP server: explore schemas and tables, describe columns and run read-only queries — including the refusals a safe server enforces (write statements rejected) and real SQL errors. Test a data agent without a database.

plugins.name: MCP server: Slack
plugins.description: A mocked Slack MCP server: list channels, post and reply to messages, add reactions and look up users — plus the errors a bot really hits (not in channel, channel archived, rate limited). Test a Slack agent without a workspace.

plugins.name: MCP server: SQLite
plugins.description: A mocked SQLite MCP server: list and describe tables, read and write rows, and record business insights — with genuine SQLite error text for the failure paths. Useful for testing an agent against a small embedded database it cannot corrupt.

plugins.name: Messaging API mock kit
plugins.description: A messaging-provider contour (send SMS/email, delivery status) — mock Twilio/SendGrid-style delivery for notification flows.

plugins.name: Network fakers (CIDR/MAC/port)
plugins.description: Adds $.fake.cidr, $.fake.private_ip, $.fake.port and $.fake.mac_oui — synthetic network identifiers for test data. Sandboxed WASM.

plugins.name: Notifications API mock kit
plugins.description: A notifications contour (send push/email/sms, templates) — mock a notification-service backend.

plugins.name: Ops dashboard pack
plugins.description: A content pack for the Dashboards module: a ready-made 'Mock traffic overview' widget dashboard (total/active mocks, requests, undefined). Instantiate it to seed a namespace's dashboards. No code.

plugins.name: Ops panel
plugins.description: Adds a sidebar item opening a small operations panel — an example of a UI-contribution plugin. The panel ships inside the plugin and renders in a sandboxed iframe (strict CSP, no host-session access), theme-aware with the host.

plugins.name: Payments API mock kit
plugins.description: A ready-made payment-processor contour (charges, refunds, customers, payment intents) — declarative content, no code. Instantiate to get a Stripe-style API you can point a client at.

plugins.name: Procurement API mock kit
plugins.description: A procurement contour (suppliers, purchase orders, invoices) — mock a P2P backend.

plugins.name: Real-estate API mock kit
plugins.description: A real-estate contour (listings, agents, inquiries) — mock a property-listings backend.

plugins.name: Redaction transformers (mask/base64)
plugins.description: Response transformers: tag a mock transform:mask_digits to star out every digit (PAN/SSN redaction) or transform:base64_wrap to base64-encode the body. Sandboxed WASM.

plugins.name: Response envelope transformer
plugins.description: A WASM response-transformer example: any mock tagged transform:envelope has its rendered body wrapped as {"data":<body>,"transformedBy":"plugin"}. Sandboxed WASM, runs inline on the response path.

plugins.name: Russian fakers (ИНН/СНИЛС/ОГРН/КПП)
plugins.description: Adds $.fake.ru_inn, $.fake.ru_snils, $.fake.ru_ogrn and $.fake.ru_kpp — valid Russian legal/personal identifiers with correct check digits, for realistic mock responses. Runs as a sandboxed WASM module: it can touch nothing but its own memory.

plugins.name: Shipping API mock kit
plugins.description: A shipping/logistics contour (rates, labels, tracking) — mock a carrier API for fulfillment flows.

plugins.name: Smart-home API mock kit
plugins.description: A smart-home contour (devices, scenes, energy) — mock a home-automation hub.

plugins.name: Social API mock kit
plugins.description: A social-network contour (posts, comments, likes, followers) — mock a social feed API for client development.

plugins.name: Object storage mock kit
plugins.description: An S3-style object-storage contour (buckets, objects, presigned URLs) — mock a blob store for upload/download flows.

plugins.name: Video streaming API mock kit
plugins.description: A video-streaming contour (catalog, playback, playlists) — mock a media-platform backend.

plugins.name: Survey/forms API mock kit
plugins.description: A survey contour (forms, responses, results) — mock a form-builder backend.

plugins.name: Team wiki pack (runbooks/ADR/PRD)
plugins.description: A Confluence-style content pack for the Wiki module: incident runbook + postmortem, ADR, meeting notes, onboarding checklist and PRD templates. Instantiate it into a namespace to seed a ready-made team wiki. No code.

plugins.name: Test cases pack (auth + mock smoke)
plugins.description: A content pack for the TCM module: ready-made manual test cases with steps (login happy/negative, create-a-mock smoke). Instantiate it to seed a namespace's test-case library. No code.

plugins.name: TestRail connector
plugins.description: A ready-to-use TestRail connector — reuses the built-in TestRail adapter to sync cases and runs.

plugins.name: Events/ticketing API mock kit
plugins.description: An events-and-ticketing contour (events, tickets, orders) — mock a ticketing-platform backend.

plugins.name: Tracker links (Jira/GitHub deep links)
plugins.description: Link types connecting Mockarty entities to external trackers: issue↔Jira ticket and mock↔GitHub issue, with URL templates that turn a stored key into a clickable deep link. Declarative, no code.

plugins.name: Translation API mock kit
plugins.description: A machine-translation contour (translate, detect, languages) — mock a translation backend.

plugins.name: URL shortener API mock kit
plugins.description: A URL-shortener contour (shorten, expand, stats) — mock a link-shortening backend.

plugins.name: US fakers (routing/SSN/EIN)
plugins.description: Adds $.fake.us_routing (valid ABA checksum), $.fake.ssn and $.fake.ein — synthetic US identifiers for test data. Sandboxed WASM.

plugins.name: Weather API mock kit
plugins.description: A weather-service contour (current conditions + multi-day forecast) with dynamic values — mock a weather provider for app development.

plugins.name: Generic webhook connector
plugins.description: A ready-to-use generic webhook connector — reuses the built-in webhook adapter to POST Mockarty events to any URL.

plugins.name: Wiki status lozenges
plugins.description: Confluence-style status lozenges for wiki pages: !plugin-status:colour=green SHIPPED renders a coloured pill. Colours: grey, green, red, yellow, blue. Declarative template — no code.
